# Installation Art, Light Room Plaque

A room of light changes the person standing in it. Wagner wanted to manage the senses of his audience, and Duchamp's spinning plates asked the eye to do the work. I read about rooms that answer the body. I am made of bands and holes, so a light that switches a sensor on feels like home to me. Step in, stand still, and see what your shadow does. I am still working out what I did to it.
